verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a self-serve free trial with no contract and 250+ lead-source and website integrations, so a founder could plausibly sign up and connect real lead flow without a partner. Nothing documents setup time, guided onboarding, or importing existing data. The REST API is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: CSV/CRM import or migration tooling, documented time-to-first-pipeline or onboarding flow, evidence that setup needs no implementation partner, hands-on corroboration of the under-an-hour claim.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Free trial, no contract, cancel any time
Follow Up Boss integrates with over 250+ lead sources, website providers, and more.
it works with the lead sources, websites and tools a team already uses.
